items.question: What floral garlands and fragrant substances adorn the offering presented to the goddess?
premises: The offering is accompanied by garlands made of various flowers.
The offering is endowed with musk and other fragrances.
These adornments specify the material richness of the ritual presentation.
items.inference: The offering to the goddess is richly adorned with diverse flower garlands and fragrant substances such as musk.
uncertainties: The exact range of substances included by śukra-ādi is not specified.
items.plain_english: The offering is endowed with garlands made of various flowers and with musk and other fragrances.
